author: elonmusk
text:
SpaceXAI just made a massive jump in image generation

Grok Imagine Image 2.0 is now #4 on Artificial Analysis’ Text-to-Image Leaderboard with 1,154 Elo.....the highest-ranked model outside OpenAI

Imagine Image 2.0: #4 — 1,154 Elo

It also sits on the Pareto frontier for quality vs price
Going from #18 to #4 in a single generation is insane

SpaceXAI is moving ridiculously fast
